WITH college_players AS (
  SELECT p.birth_country
  FROM player_college pc
  INNER JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id
),
country_counts AS (
  SELECT birth_country, COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM college_players
  GROUP BY birth_country
),
summary AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(record_count)::NUMERIC as grand_total,
    AVG(record_count::NUMERIC) as avg_count
  FROM country_counts
),
country_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.record_count::NUMERIC,
    cc.record_count::NUMERIC / s.grand_total as share,
    s.avg_count
  FROM country_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN summary s
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT record_count, share, avg_count
  FROM country_stats
  WHERE record_count > avg_count
)
SELECT
  SUM(record_count) as total_records,
  SUM(share) / COUNT(*)::NUMERIC as avg_share,
  AVG(record_count - avg_count) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
